text:
Lina R.: FYI linkcheck failed on staging after the mkdocs -> docusaurus move. CI shows duplicate-anchor errors for the heading "Quick tips" which appears in multiple pages and docusaurus now dedupes them with numeric suffixes so internal links break.

DocsBot: Linkcheck failed on build #722: https://ci.redwood/722 - step: linkcheck :warning:

Lina R.: Log excerpt:
```
WARN Duplicate anchor generated: /guides/perf.md#quick-tips -> duplicate of /tutorials/quickstart.md#quick-tips (resolved to #quick-tips-1)
WARN Broken fragment: /examples/sdk.md#quick-tips -> fragment not found
```

Omar: The slugifier creates unique anchors by appending -1, -2, etc. That breaks any hard-coded `#quick-tips` links. We should either add explicit ids to the most canonical page or update all refs to point to the canonical target.

Tess: How many refs are affected? I grepped and found 8 internal refs to `#quick-tips`, mostly in examples and READMEs. A few external blog posts may link to the guide's `#quick-tips` too.

Lina R.: Proposal: pick one canonical page for the `#quick-tips` id (preferably the guide), add an explicit `{#quick-tips}` on that heading, and update internal refs that need to target other pages to use explicit `#quick-tips-1` or better, point to the canonical guide. Also add a short note in MIGRATION.md about duplicate headings generating numeric suffixes.

QA Bot: Suggested PR checklist:
- [ ] Add explicit `{#quick-tips}` id on the canonical heading in `guides/perf.md`
- [ ] Update SDK example links to point at the canonical guide rather than per-page anchors
- [ ] Run `pnpm docs:build && pnpm docs:linkcheck` locally
- [ ] Add a small test that flags duplicate heading text across docs to avoid accidental collisions

Omar: I'll open a tiny PR that adds the explicit id and updates the 8 refs to point to the canonical guide. I'll also add a quick grep-based test under `tests/` that warns on duplicate headings.

Lina R.: Thanks. Please include a one-liner in MIGRATION.md explaining the numeric suffix behavior so contributors know why to prefer explicit ids for public anchors.

Omar: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1045 - adds explicit id to `guides/perf.md`, updates example/README links, adds `tests/check_duplicate_headings.sh`, and a migration note. Ran local linkcheck - all green.

DocsBot: PR 1045 - linkcheck step queued in CI.

Tess: Reviewed and left one minor comment about the test script's false-positive threshold.

Omar: Addressed comment and pushed fix.

DocsBot: CI for PR 1045 - all checks passed :white_check_mark:. Linkcheck green.

Lina R.: Merged. Staging linkcheck now clean. Thanks everyone. Closing thread. :tada:
